articles.title: Researchers Found a New Way to Break RSA that Doesn’t Require Factoring the Key
articles.summary:
Security researchers have demonstrated a faster way to undermine certain RSA deployments without factoring the public modulus, challenging the assumption that RSA’s practical strength always tracks the cost of integer factorization. The attack converts temporary access to a raw, unpadded RSA signing or decryption service into a lasting capability to forge signatures or decrypt chosen […]
